posts.text:
A man was arrested this afternoon after two Jews were stabbed with a screwdriver on the Upper West Side while walking to synagogue on Tish B’Av. Both incidents occurred within two blocks of @JewishCenterNY, with one occurring on the block. @msspshomrim confirms that the suspect shouted "Allah akhbar" while attacking.

@NYCMayor I’m calling you out for this, because your video and your rhetoric has created an environment where incidents like this have skyrocketed.
